families.familyIntro: TechBrotherz repairs the {name} at 3317 17 Ave SE in Calgary. This was Apple's first generation with Face ID, and the front sensor array is paired to the logic board at the factory, so Face ID cannot be carried across to a replacement part. We will tell you that before starting rather than after. The back is glass so that wireless charging works through it, which means rear glass damage is a separate repair from the screen. Walk in during opening hours, no appointment needed.
commonIssues: Cracked front glass with the picture still working
OLED burn-in or a dark band along one edge
Face ID stopped working after a repair done elsewhere
Battery no longer lasting a full day
Cracked rear glass affecting wireless charging

families.familyIntro: TechBrotherz looks at folding Samsung phones at 3317 17 Ave SE in Calgary. Be aware before you come in: the inner folding display is supplied as one sealed assembly including the hinge protection, so it is the most expensive screen part of any phone we handle, and on many folding models it is worth weighing the repair against the value of the handset. The outer cover screen is a separate and much cheaper part. We will tell you honestly which one yours needs.
commonIssues: Crease line across the inner display has become a dead band
Inner screen cracked or delaminating along the fold
Outer cover screen cracked while the inner display is fine
Hinge stiff, gritty or no longer holding position
Screen protector layer lifting at the crease
